title: 第8章 功德
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那就是在这下界陪杨天佑度过剩下的这一生，不过短短几十年而已，到时候再将其送入轮回转生，某个好出身，再渡其入仙道，等其成仙之后，再续前缘。

剩下的这几十年，就帮杨天佑做些他想做的，再为三个儿女谋一番前程，就能返回天庭，当作没事发生，慢慢安排。

瑶姬略一沉吟，脸上顿时露出了笑意。

“夫君若有意，不妨请这长溪世子来家中一叙。我替夫君相看相看，试探他是否值得托效。顺道，也可让他与婵儿见上一面。”

“这……倒确实是个主意，我与祁世子并未定下君臣名分，请他来府上倒是没什么，只是又不知该以何名义请他过来。”

杨天佑摸着短须，一张儒雅俊朗的帅脸之上，露出思索的神色。

“此事易尔。”

瑶姬嫣然一笑，皓腕轻翻。

两株通体晶莹如白玉，叶片里一缕缕脉络赤红如血的灵草，顿时出现在其手中。

“此乃赤脉草，为我前些时日特意到昆仑寻来的，其性阳刚，可将汲取的地脉之气化为气血，夯实肉身，虽非天地间有名的仙草灵药，但在凡俗之中也是难得。

本是寻来打算炮制成药，给蛟儿戬儿打基础用的，以他们兄弟的天资，若是得这赤脉草增强气血，最是能增长气力，温养灵韵，蛟儿也能借此突破地境。

要给他们兄弟用的，我已经留下了，剩下的这两株，正好用作由头，请那长溪世子过来。“

瑶姬将灵草塞入杨天佑手中。

“以此物相邀，不论他是想收你为臣，还是对婵儿有心，都能拉近关系。再不济，这赤脉草的价值，也足以偿还他派兵护卫的人情了。”

杨天佑闻言一愣，感受着手中赤脉草随后眼中露出了复杂的表情，看向了妻子。

”事事皆要娘子操心，我这个丈夫，做得实在是……“

”切莫如此，杨郎。“

瑶姬轻轻地将脑袋靠在杨天佑的肩膀上，望着那张温润俊逸的面庞。

后者伸手揽住妻子的肩膀，将脸颊贴着额头，安静地闭上了眼睛，一同依偎在凭栏处。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

That is to spend the rest of his life with Yang Tianyou in this lower world, which is only a few decades. When the time comes, he will be sent to reincarnation, with a good background, and then transferred to the immortal path, and after he becomes an immortal, he can continue his relationship.

In the remaining decades, I will help Yang Tianyou do what he wants to do, and then find a future for his three children. Then he can return to heaven, pretend that nothing happened, and slowly make arrangements.

Yao Ji pondered for a moment, and a smile suddenly appeared on her face.

"If your husband is interested, you may wish to invite the Changxi Crown Prince to come to your home for a chat. I will look at each other for your husband and test whether he is worthy of your support. By the way, I can also let him meet Chan'er."

"This... is indeed an idea. Prince Qi and I have not decided on the relationship between monarch and minister. It is okay to invite him to the house, but I don't know how to invite him here."

Yang Tianyou stroked his short beard, with a thoughtful look on his elegant and handsome face.

"It's easy."

Yao Ji smiled brightly and flicked her wrist.

Two spiritual grasses that were as crystal clear as white jade, with veins as red as blood in their leaves, suddenly appeared in his hands.

"This is red vein grass. I went to Kunlun specifically to find it a few days ago. It has a masculine nature and can turn the energy from the earth's veins into blood and strengthen the body. Although it is not a famous fairy grass elixir in the world, it is also rare in the world.

It was originally found and planned to be concocted into medicine to lay the foundation for Jiao'er and Jian'er. With their brothers' talents, if they could get this red vein grass to enhance their qi and blood, it would most likely increase their strength and warm their aura, and Jiao'er could also use it to break through the realm.

I have left the ones for their brothers. The remaining two plants are just a good excuse to invite the Prince of Changxi to come over."

Yao Ji stuffed the spiritual grass into Yang Tianyou's hand.

"Inviting you with this gift, whether he wants to accept you as a minister or has a crush on Chan'er, it can bring you closer. No matter how bad it is, the value of this red vein grass is enough to repay his favor of sending troops to protect you."

Yang Tianyou was stunned when he heard this. He felt the red vein grass in his hand and then looked at his wife with a complicated expression in his eyes.

"My wife has to worry about everything. As a husband, I really do..."

"Don't do this, Yang Lang."

Yao Ji gently rested her head on Yang Tianyou's shoulder, looking at the gentle and handsome face.

The latter put his arms around his wife's shoulders, put his cheek against his forehead, closed his eyes quietly, and leaned against the railing together.
